from collections import Counter
import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    vsep=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] and g[0][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    hsep=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==g[r][0] and g[r][0]!=bg for c in range(w))]
    # tile column bounds
    def bounds(seps,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in seps+[n]:
            b.append((s,x)); s=x+1
        return b
    cb=bounds(vsep,w); rb=bounds(hsep,h)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    src=(g[r][c] for r in range(rb[0][0],rb[0][1]) for c in range(cb[0][0],cb[0][1]))
    srcg=[[g[r][c] for c in range(cb[0][0],cb[0][1])] for r in range(rb[0][0],rb[0][1])]
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            for i,r in enumerate(range(r0,r1)):
                for j,c in enumerate(range(c0,c1)):
                    out[r][c]=srcg[i][j]
    return out

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    vsep=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    hsep=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r][c] for c in range(w)))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    def bounds(seps,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in seps+[n]: b.append((s,x)); s=x+1
        return b
    cb=bounds(vsep,w); rb=bounds(hsep,h)
    tiles=[(r0,r1,c0,c1) for (r0,r1) in rb for (c0,c1) in cb]
    def score(t):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=t
        return sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]!=bg)
    src=max(tiles,key=score)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=src
    srcg=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (a0,a1,b0,b1) in tiles:
        if (a0,b0)==(r0,c0): continue
        for i,r in enumerate(range(a0,a1)):
            for j,c in enumerate(range(b0,b1)):
                out[r][c]=srcg[i][j]
    return out
